Company: University of Sydney - Faculty of Science
Location: On campus and various high schools in Western Sydney
Salary: Pay rate is varied depending on the type of work completed
Summary:
Khuda STEM Outreach Program – paid outreach opportunities 

Khuda STEM Outreach is part of the Khuda Women in STEM program, connecting high school students from Western Sydney with university students and researchers through engaging, hands-on STEM experiences. 

We’re currently looking for HDR students who are passionate STEM communicators and enjoy working with young people to share their enthusiasm for their subject with high school students. 

You don’t need to be an expert teacher or have extensive outreach experience! We’re looking for people who are enthusiastic, approachable, curious and passionate about STEM. Depending on your interests and background, there may be opportunities to get involved with either Khuda Science or Khuda Mathematics. 

Khuda Science explores environmental science through hands-on activities covering topics such as soil, insects, biodiversity and ecosystems. We’re particularly interested in people who are passionate about environmental science and excited to share that enthusiasm with Western Sydney students. 

In Khuda Maths, you will engage with high school students from partnered schools to showcasing hands-on applications of mathematics such as the Algebraic Circuits workshop for year 9 students, and the Probabilistic Computers workshops for year 10 students. 
Interested in getting involved? Submit an Expression of Interest (EOI).
